name: GE® 500 Series 30" Stainless Steel Freestanding Gas Range
shortDescription: GE® 500 Series 30" Stainless Steel Freestanding Gas Range features Crisp Mode, Extra-Large Integrated Non-Stick Griddle, 15,000 BTU Power Boil™ Burner, Edge-to-Edge Cooktop, Precise Simmer Burner, Center Oval Burner, Self-Clean with Steam Clean, and Oven Storage Drawer.

features.text: Crisp Mode

Crisp Mode uses the bake and broil elements to deliver air fry-like results. Perfect for your favorite air-fried foods, this mode uses a preheat to get to temperature, then delivers fantastic crispy results.
Express Preheat
Get food on the table quicker thanks to a fast preheat oven. In just 7 minutes, you have a perfectly preheated oven.
5-Burner Gas
Five powerful gas burners make for an efficient cooking experience on this expansive and flexible cooktop.
Extra-Large Integrated Non-Stick Griddle
With an integrated griddle that is 20% larger than leading competition, you can cook up to six grilled cheeses at once.
15,000 BTU Power Boil™ Burner
Boil water faster with a 15,000 BTU Power Boil™ element that delivers high heat for quick boiling.
Edge-to-Edge Cooktop
A large cooking surface gives you extra room for pots and pans of all sizes and lets cookware move easily from burner to burner.
Center Oval Burner
Custom cookware and griddles easily fit on this powerful fifth central oval burner that offers a flexible cooking solution.
Precise Simmer Burner
Prepare your delicate dishes over the low, even heat of this precise simmer burner.
Self-Clean with Steam Clean
Save time and effort by using the self-cleaning function for deep-clean situations or enjoy frequent cleanings without the need for kits or extra steps thanks to the steam clean oven function.
Heavy-Duty, Dishwasher-Safe Grates
Enjoy a safe and easy-to-clean solution thanks to these heavy-duty, dishwasher-safe grates.
Oven Storage Drawer
This model features a removable oven storage drawer that offers the perfect place to store cookware and other kitchen accessories.
Large Capacity Oven
Cook an entire meal at once with room to spare in this oven with 5.3 cubic foot capacity.
In-Oven Broil
This oven with full coverage broil element means hassle-free meal preparation with simple, in-oven broiling.
New Easy-to-Use Controls
Updated and improved controls allow for easy navigation of all cooking options and modes.
Nickel Racks
This gas range with nickel racks provides a durable design that handles heavy baking dishes with ease.
